howto.what: 它会先读任务上下文契约和信任建立方法,再基于已授权的上下文规划如何赢得客户信任、拿到合适权限,并如实报告缺失的能力或未运行的检查。

howto.what_en: It first reads the task context contract and the earn-trust method, then plans how to earn customer trust and appropriate access from the permitted context, honestly reporting missing capabilities or unrun checks.
howto.when_en: Takes over when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement; when called by @fde it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope.
